name: Krea AI
tagline: Krea AI is a creative platform focused on real-time AI generation: you see images update live as you type or draw, enabling an intuitive visual exploration process. Its upscaler, enhancer, and style-transfer tools let creators refine AI-generated and real photographs with exceptional quality. Designers and visual artists use Krea for its unique real-time feedback loop that makes iterating on visual ideas feel like sketching.
